cn.t: Critics celebrate Eboni Booth's Pulitzer-winning "Primary Trust" as a quietly marvelous, lyrical triumph. Petey McGee's portrayal of lonely Kenneth earns widespread praise in this disarming tale of hope, healing, and human connection.
